name: cronboard
description: GNOME Shell extension for managing your cron jobs from the top panel

scripts.build: npm run check && esbuild src/extension.ts src/prefs.ts --bundle --format=esm --target=firefox115 '--external:gi://*' '--external:resource://*' --outdir=dist && cp metadata.json stylesheet.css data/cronboard-run dist/ && cp -r icons dist/
scripts.nested: MUTTER_DEBUG_DUMMY_MODE_SPECS=1280x800 dbus-run-session -- sh -c 'gnome-shell --nested --wayland & sleep 3; gnome-extensions enable cronboard@seniru-dilmith.github.io; wait'
scripts.pack: npm run build && gnome-extensions pack dist --extra-source=cronboard-run --extra-source=icons --force
